items.label: Standard
items.text:
Sentences in narration should be Standard: Use multiclausal sentences to vary prose rhythm.
Does not affect dialogue

items.label: Sprawling
items.text:
Sentences in narration should be Sprawling: Long, clause-heavy sentences run as the default. 
Does not affect dialogue

items.label: Percussive
items.text:
Sentences in narration should be Percussive: Short punchy sentences dominate. Fragments are permitted.
Does not affect dialogue

items.label: Dynamic
items.text:
Sentences in narration should be Dynamic: Sentence length follows what the scene is doing. Use multiclausal sentences to vary prose rhythm.
- Physical action: short sentences and fragments. Visceral verbs, minimal subordination. "He lunged. A crack of bone. Pain exploded."
- Interiority and observation: longer, subordinated sentences that let a thought extend. The scene may pause while the character thinks.

items.label: Uniform
items.text:
Sentences in narration should be Uniform: Sentences hold a consistent length and shape. Little variation between adjacent sentences. 
Does not affect dialogue

items.label: One long, then one short
items.text: one long sentence and then a short one, as a repeating pattern
